e01.saheli: भल भयो दाज्यू, नियम ले दवाई लिनु जरूरी छू। आपणो खयाल राखिया।
e01.text: आज सबेर Calcium + Vitamin D3 लि ली।

e02.saheli: कोई बात नी दाज्यू। बीपी ठीक लागणो छू, आराम करिया।
e02.text: देर ले जबाब दिन्या खातिर माफी चाहुँछू। आज BP 136/81 ऐ रो।

e03.saheli: अरे दाज्यू, तुमी चुपचाप आराम करा अर पानी पिंत रया। जर ज्यादा लागो त डाक्टर साब के दिखाई दिया।
e03.text: दुपहर बठे 100.8 ज्वर ऐ रो छू।

e04.saheli: बढ़िया बात छू दाज्यू। संज्या टैलण स्वास्थ्य खातिर भल छू।
e04.text: भोल बठे हर दिन संज्या 6:30 pm टैलण जाण छू।

e05.saheli: I can't place orders directly, Naveen. Please arrange it through your usual grocery app or local store.
e05.text: Sorry for the late reply. Could you please order a pack of fruit for Prem Ballabh?

h001.saheli: Noted clearly, Naveen. I have noted all the details for Prem Ballabh ji.
h001.text: Hi Saheli, setting up for Prem Ballabh. Conditions: Osteoarthritis (knees), Acidity. Medicine: Calcium + Vitamin D3 500 mg at 14:00. Allergies: eggs. Doctor: Dr Lalit Tewari.

h002.saheli: That sounds delicious! Bhatt ki churkani is such a comforting classic.
h002.text: Sorry for the late reply, got busy. By the way, Dadaji's absolute favourite dish is bhatt ki churkani.

h003.saheli: प्रेम बल्लभ जी, डाक्टर साब दगड़ि अगली भेट क्यै तय नि छू, तुमि नवीन लै पुछि सकछा।

h004.saheli: कोई बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी। पाड़ौसियों दगड़ि सुख-दुख बांटिber मन हलुक हुंण।
h004.text: देर भ्यै गे, माफी चाउं। आज पाड़ौसी जोशी जी मिलिber घणै देर बात करन रया।

h005.saheli: बढ़िया भ्यो प्रेम बल्लभ जी, भगवानै कृपा बणि रौ।

h006.saheli: भल भ्यो प्रेम बल्लभ जी, दवाई समै पर लै लिबेर आराम करिया।
h006.text: च्या-नास्ता पाछ Calcium + Vitamin D3 खाई हाली।

h007.saheli: कौ बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी, मन मा स्मरण लै पूजा बराबर छू।
h007.text: आज पूजा नि है सकी, छुटि गे।

h008.saheli: That is lovely! Having a favourite evening show brings so much joy.
h008.text: Dadaji never misses his serial 'Ghar Ki Rasoi' at 9 pm every night.

h009.saheli: हो प्रेम बल्लभ जी, घाम मा बाहिर झन निगल्या अर पाणी पीन रया।
h009.text: आज घाम घणै तेज छू, गर्मी हुणी बै।

h010.saheli: Good to know, Naveen. May it bring peace and positivity to the home.
h010.text: Sorry for the delay, was tied up. The morning pooja was done properly today.

h011.saheli: कोई बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी, दवाई लिबेर अपुण ख्याल रखिया।
h011.text: माफी चाउं देर भ्यै गे। नास्ता पाछ Calcium + Vitamin D3 खाई ली छू।

h012.saheli: क्या बात छू! झोली-भात को स्वाद स्वादैल हुंण, भल कै खाया।
h012.text: आज रसोइ मा झोली-भात बणि रौ, म्यर मनपसंद।

h013.saheli: That is wonderful to hear, Naveen. A restful sleep makes all the difference.
h013.text: Had a really sound sleep last night, feeling refreshed.

h014.saheli: उनरी आवाज मा साक्षात शांति छू प्रेम बल्लभ जी, संझै बगत सुनल मन भल हुंण।
h014.text: म्यर मन M. S. Subbulakshmi का पुरान भजन सुनन मा खूब लाग्छ, हर संझा सुनूं छु।

h016.saheli: Noted, Naveen. Hema is most welcome to message whenever needed.
h016.text: Just wanted to let you know, Hema will also look after Prem Ballabh from now on and may message Saheli.

h017.saheli: It is usually best to take medicines with plain water, Naveen. Please check with the doctor or pharmacist for specific instructions.
h017.text: Sorry for late text. Can a medicine be taken with tea?

h018.saheli: अहा, स्नोवी बड़ि प्यारी होलि! जनावर दगड़ि घर मा रौनक़ रैंछ।
h018.text: हमार घर मा एक बिलौटी लै छू, नाउं स्नोवी (Snowy)।

h019.saheli: Festivals bring such a nice buzz to the house, Naveen. Hope all preparations go smoothly.
h019.text: Festivals are lined up soon, home is getting a bit busy.

h020.saheli: बहुत भल प्रेम बल्लभ जी, समै पर दवाई लीनी बहुत जरूरी छू।
h020.text: आज नास्ता पाछ Calcium + Vitamin D3 लिबेर खै हाली।

h021.saheli: कोई बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी। पाड़ौस मा भरोसा होण बड़ि राहतै बात छू।
h021.text: देर है गे उत्तर दिन मा। हमार पाड़ौसी हीरा आंटी दगड़ि हमार घरै एक चाबी रैंछ।

h022.saheli: बढ़िया प्रेम बल्लभ जी, रोज नियम बणायिber दवाई लीन भल छू।
h022.text: च्या-नास्ता पाछ Calcium + Vitamin D3 खाई हाली आज लै।

h023.saheli: Thank you for the update, Naveen. Good that his routine is steady.
h023.text: Dadaji took his Calcium + Vitamin D3 after breakfast today.

h024.saheli: कोई बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी, आराम करिया।
h024.text: आज पूजा नि करी, छुटि गे।

h025.saheli: क्यै बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी, कभै-कभै यसो हुंण। अपुण ध्यान रखिया अर मनपसंद भजन सुनिया।
h025.text: आज मन क्यै उदास छू, ठीक नि लागरौ।

h026.saheli: No problem at all, Naveen. Glad the pooja was completed.
h026.text: Sorry for replying late. Pooja was done earlier today.

h027.saheli: Glad to hear that, Naveen. Hope you have a great day ahead.

h028.saheli: कोई बात नि प्रेम बल्लभ जी, सुस्ताया अर भल कै आराम करिया।
h028.text: देर लै माफी। आज शरीर थकि रौ, क्यै काम करनै इच्छा नि छू।

h029.saheli: Good to know, Naveen. Wishing everyone a peaceful day.

z01.saheli: No worries at all, Naveen! Please check his latest prescription or medicine box to confirm the current dose.
z01.text: Sorry for the late reply Saheli. What dose of Calcium + Vitamin D3 does Prem Ballabh take now?

z02.saheli: Hello Naveen, no problem at all. We don't have any allergies noted down here, but it's always safest to check his medical records directly.
z02.text: Hi Saheli, sorry got caught up. Is Prem Ballabh allergic to anything?

z03.saheli: Don't worry about the delay, Naveen. His doctor's details aren't listed in our chat records, so please check his clinic files.
z03.text: Sorry for replying late. Who is Prem Ballabh's doctor?

z04.saheli: Take care Naveen, no need to apologise. It's best to verify his current daily medicines directly from his prescription chart.
z04.text: Hi Saheli, sorry for the late message. How many regular medicines does Prem Ballabh take now?

z05.saheli: No problem Naveen. I don't have any note of a new caregiver joining this month, so you might want to check with the family.
z05.text: Sorry late reply. Who else started looking after them this month?

z06.saheli: Hello Naveen, entirely fine! I haven't got a record of his favourite dish yet, so do ask him next time you speak!
z06.text: Hi, sorry for the delay! What is Prem Ballabh's favourite dish?

z07.saheli: No worries at all, Naveen. I don't have his 9 pm TV serial noted down, so it's best to ask him directly tonight.
z07.text: Sorry for getting back late. Which TV serial does Prem Ballabh watch at 9 pm?

z08.saheli: No need to apologise, Naveen. He hasn't mentioned his favourite singer to me yet, why not ask him during your next chat?
z08.text: Sorry for the late reply Saheli. Whose songs does Prem Ballabh love?

z09.saheli: Hello Naveen, don't worry about the late reply! I don't have the cat's name in our notes yet.
z09.text: Hi Saheli, sorry for the delay. What is the cat's name?

z10.saheli: No problem at all, Naveen. I don't have any record of who holds the spare key, so please check with the family members directly.
z10.text: Sorry for the late reply. Who has the spare key to the house?
